description: Curated, sourced milestones in the history of GitHub. month/day are null when only the year or month is well established.

milestones.title: The first commit to GitHub
milestones.summary: Chris Wanstrath makes the first commit to the GitHub codebase, a side project started with Tom Preston-Werner after a Ruby meetup in San Francisco. PJ Hyett and Scott Chacon soon join as co-founders.

milestones.title: GitHub launches publicly
milestones.summary: After a private beta, GitHub officially launches as a hosted Git service built around social coding: profiles, forks, and a network of collaborators.

milestones.title: Gist is born
milestones.summary: GitHub launches Gist, a way to share snippets and small files where every gist is itself a Git repository.

milestones.title: GitHub Pages
milestones.summary: GitHub Pages lets anyone publish a static website straight from a repository, later powered by Jekyll, the static site generator created by Tom Preston-Werner.

milestones.title: One million repositories
milestones.summary: GitHub passes one million hosted repositories, roughly two and a half years after launch.

milestones.title: First outside investment
milestones.summary: After four bootstrapped, profitable years, GitHub takes its first outside investment: $100 million led by Andreessen Horowitz.

milestones.title: Atom, a hackable text editor
milestones.summary: GitHub introduces Atom, a 'hackable text editor for the 21st century', and open sources it a few months later.

milestones.title: Atom Shell becomes Electron
milestones.summary: The framework built for Atom is renamed Electron. It goes on to power many desktop apps, including Visual Studio Code, Slack and Discord.

milestones.title: Git Large File Storage
milestones.summary: GitHub announces Git LFS, an open source Git extension for versioning large files such as audio, video and datasets.

milestones.title: Microsoft agrees to acquire GitHub
milestones.summary: Microsoft announces an agreement to acquire GitHub for $7.5 billion in stock, with GitHub continuing to operate independently.

milestones.title: GitHub Actions is announced
milestones.summary: At GitHub Universe 2018, GitHub unveils Actions in beta: automation workflows that live right next to your code.

milestones.title: Acquisition closes, Nat Friedman becomes CEO
milestones.summary: Microsoft completes the acquisition and Nat Friedman becomes GitHub's CEO.

milestones.title: Free private repositories
milestones.summary: GitHub Free gains unlimited private repositories (initially with up to three collaborators), removing one of the biggest reasons to pay for a personal account.

milestones.title: GitHub Sponsors
milestones.summary: Announced at GitHub Satellite in Berlin, Sponsors lets the community fund the open source developers they depend on.

milestones.title: GitHub Actions and Packages leave beta
milestones.summary: At Universe 2019, GitHub Actions (with built-in CI/CD) and GitHub Packages become generally available, free for public repositories. The GitHub Archive Program is announced the same day.

milestones.title: npm joins GitHub
milestones.summary: GitHub announces it is acquiring npm, the company behind the JavaScript package registry.

milestones.title: GitHub is free for teams
milestones.summary: Private repositories with unlimited collaborators become free for all organizations, including teams.

milestones.title: Codespaces and Discussions
milestones.summary: At GitHub's first virtual Satellite, GitHub announces Codespaces (cloud dev environments powered by VS Code), Discussions, and code and secret scanning.

milestones.title: The Arctic Code Vault
milestones.summary: A snapshot of public repositories taken on February 2, 2020 is deposited in the Arctic World Archive in Svalbard, designed to last 1,000 years.

milestones.title: GitHub CLI 1.0
milestones.summary: The official `gh` command line tool reaches 1.0, bringing pull requests, issues and more to the terminal.

milestones.title: main becomes the default branch name
milestones.summary: New repositories on GitHub use `main` as the default branch name instead of `master`.

milestones.title: GitHub Copilot technical preview
milestones.summary: GitHub introduces Copilot, an AI pair programmer built with OpenAI, as a technical preview in Visual Studio Code.

milestones.title: Thomas Dohmke becomes CEO
milestones.summary: Thomas Dohmke succeeds Nat Friedman as GitHub's CEO.

milestones.title: Copilot is generally available
milestones.summary: GitHub Copilot becomes generally available to individual developers, free for verified students and maintainers of popular open source projects.

milestones.title: Atom is sunset
milestones.summary: As announced in June 2022, GitHub archives Atom and its repositories. Its biggest legacy, Electron, lives on.

milestones.title: 100 million developers
milestones.summary: GitHub announces that more than 100 million developers use the platform.

milestones.title: 2FA becomes mandatory for contributors
milestones.summary: GitHub begins requiring two-factor authentication for developers who contribute code on GitHub.com, rolling out in groups through 2023.

milestones.title: Copilot Chat is generally available
milestones.summary: Copilot Chat, a conversational assistant in VS Code and Visual Studio, becomes generally available in all Copilot plans.

milestones.title: Copilot Workspace preview
milestones.summary: GitHub previews Copilot Workspace, a task-centric environment that goes from an issue to a plan to code.

milestones.title: Copilot goes multi-model
milestones.summary: At Universe 2024, GitHub announces model choice in Copilot, including models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI.

milestones.title: Copilot Free and 150M developers
milestones.summary: GitHub launches a free tier of Copilot in VS Code and shares that it has passed 150 million developers.

milestones.title: Copilot coding agent
milestones.summary: At Microsoft Build, GitHub announces the Copilot coding agent: assign an issue to Copilot and it works asynchronously in an Actions-powered environment, then opens a pull request for review.

milestones.title: GitHub moves into Microsoft CoreAI
milestones.summary: Thomas Dohmke announces he will step down as CEO to found a new startup; GitHub's leadership continues as part of Microsoft's CoreAI organization.

milestones.title: Agent HQ
milestones.summary: At Universe 2025, GitHub announces Agent HQ, a mission control for assigning and tracking coding agents from multiple providers directly on GitHub.
